Katrina Kaif's Mother's NGO Work in Tamil Nadu Highlighted

Suzanne, mother of actor Katrina Kaif, has been working with children and families through her NGO, Relief Projects India (RPI), in villages around Usilampatti in Madurai district, Tamil Nadu. Her work with the grassroots non-profit spans 15 years.
